note: [L] makes the same assembly: the Wilson top (Pass.at_top) followed by downward induction (Pass.cycle), with per-step validity from Ingredients.gates. The difference: the induction runs over address teams and passages rather than over the manuscript's classes of densities.

snippet.text:
lemma at_top : ∃ T:Team (stageP A.B.a N n),Top N n T := by
  choose f hf using fun (s:Signed) (v:Site (A.B.a.S.side N n))=>Tent.affable (N:=N) s v
  let y: Y:= ⟨_,left_mem_Icc.mpr (show A.B.a.clock.hatBeta N/2 ≤ 2*A.B.a.clock.hatBeta N from by linarith [A.B.a.fits.delayed N])⟩
  have hp i v : amid (f i v) ((0:Show P).proper) i v:=by
    obtain ⟨x,hx,h⟩:= hf i v y
    exact ⟨⟨_,_,x.reg_site, x.reg_support,x.forced_support,x.forced_inventory,x.forced_tests,fun _ _=> rfl,fun _ _=>rfl⟩,hx,h⟩
  let T:Team P:= ⟨f,hp⟩
  refine ⟨T,fun x=>?_⟩
  have h:= (speaks R he hr N n).2 x x.property
  obtain ⟨k,hk⟩:= corresponds T (launch (A:=A) N n x).activities rfl rfl h.2.1.valid.labels (fun i v=> hf i v _)
  exact ⟨k,hk⟩

proof_context.conclusion: The Wilson starts give a top team satisfying Top at level N.

snippet.text:
lemma cycle : Nonempty (Circle N n V):=by
  obtain ⟨p,hp⟩:= at_top (N:=N) (n:=n) R he hr
  let step (m:ℕ) (h:m<N)(T:Team (stageP A.B.a (m+1) n)) := (passage g (V m h) T).choose
  let W (m:ℕ)(hv:m≤N): Team (stageP A.B.a m n):= Nat.decreasingInduction (motive:=fun m h=>Team (stageP A.B.a m n)) step p hv
  refine ⟨⟨W,?_,?_⟩⟩; · rwa [show W N le_rfl=p from Nat.decreasingInduction_self ..]
  intro m hm; rw [show W m hm.le=step m hm (W (m+1) hm) from Nat.decreasingInduction_succ_left ..]; exact (passage g (V m hm) _).choose_spec

proof_context.conclusion: From the Wilson top, a downward induction (Nat.decreasingInduction with passage) builds a Circle: a team at every level m <= N with the top condition and passages between adjacent levels.

lemma gates (W : PathData G) (c : Clip) (β v : ℝ) :
    (finish W c P X d β v).activities.Valid P δ w := by
  obtain ⟨κ,γ,u,he,hp,hg⟩ := H.to_shelves.pays
  obtain ⟨ha,hb⟩ := Work.H03.answer _ n _ _ (folio G n) _ _ _ he
  refine ⟨?_,ha,hb,he.stamp.boundE,Work.H02.answer _ n _ _ (folio G n) _ _ κ γ _ _ hg he hp⟩
  exact ⟨he.stamp.regular.smooth,he.stamp.regular.at_flat,he.stamp.regular.vanish⟩

proof_context.conclusion: Each finished step's activities are Valid, using the fusion and address answers Work.H02/H03.
